channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: BREAKING: US, Iran announce ceasefire agreement
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced a ceasefire agreement with Iran.

item.title: US-Iran ceasefire deal announced, Trump says Strait of Hormuz reopening
item.description: Trump announces that a ceasefire deal with Iran has been agreed, and that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen for shipping.

item.title: Gaza mourns four killed in Israeli strike
item.description: Cries of grief echoed through Gaza City for four Palestinians killed near the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza.

item.title: Six people killed as helicopters collide over Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Two helicopters collided in midair before crashing into car park of electric vehicle dealership, fire service says.

item.title: Twelve killed in plane crash in US state of Missouri
item.description: Plane crashes near Butler Memorial Airport near Kansas City, with authorities reporting skydivers on board.

item.title: Trump says Israeli attacks on Beirut unjustified, puts Iran deal at risk
item.description: Trump has commented on Truth Social, condemning Israeli attacks on Beirut as the cease fire is to be extended.

item.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
item.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

item.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
item.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.
